media.name: Sonarr
media.category_description: Self-hosted media management (TV, movies, anime, manga, books, music)
media.notes: Mature .NET Smart PVR. Long-running (10+ years), large contributor base, CI on every PR, extensive test suite, tagged releases with signed artifacts. The reference for media-management tools.

security.name: Vaultwarden
security.category_description: Security-sensitive tools (password managers, secrets, auth, identity)
security.notes: Rust Bitwarden-compatible server. Audited, conservative release cadence, strong secret handling, mandatory HTTPS, SSO via OIDC. The reference for anything that touches credentials.

dashboard.name: Homer
dashboard.notes: Static Vue dashboard. No backend attack surface to speak of, no auth, no DB. Low-risk category reference — anything more complex than Homer should be scrutinised harder.

networking.name: Pi-hole
networking.category_description: Networking, DNS, proxy, VPN, reverse proxy, routing
networking.notes: Network-level ad blocker with a PHP web UI. Sits on the network edge, handles DNS for everything behind it. Admin UI has had auth issues historically — the reference for 'network-positioned tools with a web UI'.

monitoring.name: Uptime Kuma
monitoring.category_description: Monitoring, metrics, logging, alerting, status pages
monitoring.notes: Node.js uptime monitor. Very popular, active development. Single-maintainer bus factor is a known concern. Reference for monitoring tools.
